gaps.sentence: They say ___ apple a day keeps the doctor away.
gaps.explanation: 'An apple a day…' — 'an' before the vowel sound, 'a' before 'day'.

gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: The kids spent ___ afternoon playing in the garden.
gaps.explanation: 'The afternoon' and 'the garden' (our garden) are definite in context.

gaps.sentence: She was appointed ___ managing director at just thirty-four.
gaps.explanation: After 'appoint/elect/name + unique role' no article is used.

gaps.sentence: She works as ___ editor for a travel magazine.
He plays ___ violin in the youth orchestra.
___ disabled are offered free entry on Sundays.
gaps.explanation: 'The disabled' = disabled people as a group.
